title: Skill frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file. Only the Agent Skills specification's fields that every agent we support documents are allowed; allowed-tools is left out because it's experimental.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. It must match the skill's folder name.

description.description: What the skill does and the kinds of request it's for. Agents use it to decide when to load the skill.

metadata.description: String keys and string values only, as the specification requires.

owner.description: The GitHub team that owns the skill.

updated.description: The date the skill's files last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

deprecated.description: The name of the skill that replaces this one.

source.description: Where a vendored skill came from, as owner/repository@commit.
